niche: online spiritual and shadow work courses
prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
engine_stated_criteria: Udemy: *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on whether you want a psychological, contemplative, or explicitly religious approach. Here are some options worth comparing:

### Shadow work
- **Work With Your Shadow** — A structured, seven-module course with teaching videos, a learning journal, guided practices, and recorded coaching/Q&A. A good fit if you want a guided, reflective format. [Course details](https://workwithyourshadow.com/)
- **Udemy: *Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self*** — A lower-commitment, self-paced option with exercises, journaling prompts, and meditations. The instructor’s background is in spiritual teaching, Reiki, and tarot, so treat it as personal-development education rather than clinical therapy. [Course page](https://www.udemy.com/course/shadow_work/)
- **Wild Success: Shadow Work Foundations** — Covers safety, ownership, integration, nervous-system regulation, and inner-child work. It may suit people looking for a more intensive or facilitator-oriented framework; review the program’s claims, cost, and qualifications carefully. [Program details](https://sw.wildsuccess.com/)

### Spiritual practice
- **WCCM online courses** — A solid choice for learning meditation and building a regular contemplative practice; its courses include a six-week introduction. [Course list](https://wccm.org/courses/)
- **Mindworks Buddhist meditation courses** — Short, structured modules with guided meditations, teaching videos, readings, and contemplations. Best if you’re interested in a Buddhist framework. [Course details](https://mindworks.org/meditation-courses/buddhist-courses/)
- **Shalem Institute graduate offerings** — Includes courses in contemplative practice and meditation, with options grounded in Christian spirituality and interfaith approaches. [Offerings](https://shalem.org/programs/offerings-by-shalem-graduates/)
- **Ananda online courses** — A fit if you’re drawn to yoga and meditation within a specific spiritual tradition. [Course catalog](https://www.ananda.org/online-courses/)

**A practical starting point:** choose one shadow-work course and one meditation course, rather than trying to do several intensive programs at once. Before enrolling, check the instructor’s training, whether there’s live support, the refund policy, and whether the course clearly distinguishes spiritual guidance from mental-health care. Shadow work can bring up difficult memories or emotions; if that happens, pause and consider working with a licensed mental-health professional.
